name: Energy Solutions
description: Electricity plans, renewable energy certificates, and solar installation for homes and businesses through our licensed retail partners.
overview: Singapore's Open Electricity Market lets you choose who supplies your electricity. We help you compare what's actually available across our retail partners, explain how each plan structure behaves, and handle the switch — your supply and grid connection never change.
benefits: Plans compared across our retail partners
Guidance matched to your usage pattern

items.name: Residential Plan
items.summary: A locked rate for the whole contract term, so your unit price doesn't move when the tariff does.
specs: Rate fixed for the contract term

detail.description: Your price per kWh is agreed upfront and stays the same for the length of the contract, regardless of how the regulated tariff moves. This is the plan most households choose when they want certainty over chasing the lowest possible rate — if the tariff rises during your term, you're insulated; if it falls, you stay at your agreed rate.

specSheet.label: Rate structure
specSheet.value: Fixed cents per kWh for the full term

features: Rate agreed before you sign — no surprises mid-term
Full Fact Sheet and Consumer Advisory provided before signup
We handle the switch application end to end
No interruption to your electricity supply

items.name: Commercial Plan
items.summary: A guaranteed percentage or fixed amount below the regulated tariff, moving as the tariff moves.

detail.description: Instead of a fixed number, you pay a set discount against the regulated tariff. Because the tariff is reviewed quarterly, your rate moves with it — down when the tariff falls, up when it rises — but always below what you'd pay on the tariff itself. Suits households comfortable with some variability in exchange for always tracking the market.

specSheet.label: Rate structure
specSheet.value: Set discount off the prevailing regulated tariff

features: Guaranteed to stay below the regulated tariff
Benefit automatically when tariffs fall
Full Fact Sheet and Consumer Advisory provided before signup
No interruption to your electricity supply

items.name: Green Energy Solutions
items.summary: Two different rates depending on the time of day — cheaper overnight, higher during peak hours.

detail.description: You're charged one rate during defined peak hours and a lower rate outside them. This only works in your favour if a meaningful share of your consumption genuinely happens off-peak — households that run laundry, charging, or air-conditioning overnight. If your usage is concentrated in the evening, a fixed or discount plan will usually work out better, and we'll tell you so.

specSheet.label: Rate structure
specSheet.value: Separate peak and off-peak rates per kWh

features: Meaningful savings if your usage is genuinely off-peak weighted
We review your consumption pattern before recommending it
Full Fact Sheet and Consumer Advisory provided before signup
No interruption to your electricity supply
